What the fence is for

A staged copy is not a convenience. It is the whole reason the run can be audited at all, because the manifest is written before the model reads anything.

The second paragraph argues that a snapshot beats a live read, since a tree that changes under a run makes the audit a work of fiction rather than a record.

The third paragraph closes on the operator, who chose the folder and should be able to see exactly which files that choice turned into.
